announcements.headline: CEO Interview – Azteca in Production
announcements.insight: Cadence Minerals confirms Azteca is in production following the November licence grant. This operational milestone validates the capital raised earlier this year.

announcements.headline: Azteca Operating Licence Granted
announcements.insight: The Azteca operating licence grant follows the September capital raise and commissioning progress. This regulatory milestone advances project development for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Interim results for six months ended 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: Interim results for six months ended 30 June 2026 are released. This follows the September capital raises intended to advance Azteca.

announcements.headline: Result of Oversubscribed WRAP Retail Offer
announcements.insight: The oversubscribed retail offer follows the September WRAP announcement. This indicates successful investor interest in the Azteca project funding.

announcements.headline: WRAP Retail Offer for up to £450,000
announcements.insight: A retail offer follows the £1.80m raise in September, indicating continued capital raising to fund the completed Azteca refurbishment and its commissioning phase.

announcements.headline: £1.80 million raised to advance Azteca
announcements.insight: Following refurbishment completion in September, £1.80 million is raised to advance Azteca's cold and wet commissioning phase.

announcements.headline: Azteca Cold and Wet Commissioning Underway
announcements.insight: Following the completion of refurbishment in September, Azteca has commenced commissioning. This operational milestone suggests progress toward resuming production activities.

announcements.headline: Azteca Refurbishment Complete
announcements.insight: Azteca refurbishment is now complete, following the progress update in August. This operational milestone may signal readiness for production or further development steps.

announcements.headline: Result of GM
announcements.insight: The General Meeting result follows the August 5 update. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for implementation details.

announcements.headline: Azteca refurbishment progresses from 77% to 87%
announcements.insight: Azteca refurbishment progress follows the July update. This operational milestone suggests continued execution of the project previously outlined.

announcements.headline: Director Share Purchases
announcements.insight: Director share purchases indicate insider confidence in Cadence Minerals. This follows recent updates on the Azteca project and Sonora Lithium developments.

announcements.headline: Further information regarding General Meeting
announcements.insight: Further details regarding the General Meeting follow the earlier AGM result announcement in July. Shareholders should monitor for any subsequent corporate actions arising from this meeting.

announcements.headline: Investor Presentation via Investor Meet Company
Sonora Lithium Project
announcements.insight: The AGM result was announced in July. Shareholders should watch for further updates on the Sonora Lithium Project.

announcements.headline: Azteca Refurbishment Update
announcements.insight: Cadence Minerals provides an Azteca execution update following earlier restart and results filings. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent court sanction details.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: The AGM results follow the December 2025 annual results and recent Azteca updates. Shareholders should monitor subsequent execution developments.

announcements.headline: Azteca Execution Update
announcements.insight: Cadence Minerals provides an update on Azteca following the May restart. This follows the June annual results, indicating ongoing operational progress.

announcements.headline: Annual Results for the year ended 31 December 2025
announcements.insight: Cadence Minerals publishes annual results for the year ended 31 December 2025. This follows the Azteca Restart Update in May 2026.

announcements.headline: Azteca Restart Update
announcements.insight: Cadence Minerals provides an update on the Aztec Restart. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on operational progress and potential financial implications.
